events.title: Fantasy Football: 2026-27 Top 5 Scoring WRs
events.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the named wide receiver finishes the 2026-27 NFL regular season (Weeks 1 through 18) ranked among the top 5 wide receivers by total fantasy points under standard PPR (points-per-reception) scoring per the default scoring of ESPN Fantasy Sports. Otherwise, that market will resolve to "No".

Only regular-season games count; postseason (playoff) games are excluded. If two or more wide receivers are tied such that more than 5 would qualify for the top 5, the tie will be broken by higher fantasy points per game average for the 2026 NFL regular season, and if a tie still persists, by last name in alphabetical order, so that exactly 5 wide receivers are classified as top 5.

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past January 26, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the rankings cannot be determined within this timeframe, all markets in this event will resolve to "No".

The resolution source will be official season-total statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).

events.title: Fantasy Football: WR Points Leader - Week 1
events.description:
This is a polymarket to predict which wide receiver will record the most fantasy points of any WR in Week 1 of the 2025–26 NFL regular season.

If the listed player records the most points of any wide receiver in Week 1 using ESPN’s FFL Points Per Reception (PPR) scoring, the market will resolve to "Yes". Otherwise, it will resolve to "No".

If two or more wide receivers finish with the same number of fantasy points to the decimal, this market will resolve to the player whose last name is listed first alphabetically.

If one or more individual Week 1 games are canceled and not completed by September 9, 2025, at 11:59 PM ET, the market will still resolve based on the fantasy points recorded using ESPN’s FFL Points Per Reception (PPR) official scoring for the Week 1 games that were scored by ESPN.

If the entire Week 1 of the 2025–26 NFL regular season is canceled, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be the ESPN Fantasy Football Leaders page for Week 1: https://fantasy.espn.com/football/leaders.

This is a polymarket to predict which wide receiver will record the most fantasy points of any WR in Week 1 of the 2025–26 NFL regular season.

If the listed player records the most points of any wide receiver in Week 1 using ESPN’s FFL Points Per Reception (PPR) scoring, the market will resolve to "Yes". Otherwise, it will resolve to "No".

If two or more wide receivers finish with the same number of fantasy points to the decimal, this market will resolve to the player whose last name is listed first alphabetically.

If one or more individual Week 1 games are canceled and not completed by September 9, 2025, at 11:59 PM ET, the market will still resolve based on the fantasy points recorded using ESPN’s FFL Points Per Reception (PPR) official scoring for the Week 1 games that were scored by ESPN.

If the entire Week 1 of the 2025–26 NFL regular season is canceled, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be the ESPN Fantasy Football Leaders page for Week 1: https://fantasy.espn.com/football/leaders.

events.title: Fantasy Football: 2026-27 Top 12 Scoring WRs
events.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the named wide receiver finishes the 2026-27 NFL regular season (Weeks 1 through 18) ranked among the top 12 wide receivers by total fantasy points under standard PPR (points-per-reception) scoring per the default scoring of ESPN Fantasy Sports. Otherwise, that market will resolve to "No".

Only regular-season games count; postseason (playoff) games are excluded. If two or more wide receivers are tied such that more than 12 would qualify for the top 12, the tie will be broken by higher fantasy points per game average for the 2026 NFL regular season, and if a tie still persists, by last name in alphabetical order, so that exactly 12 wide receivers are classified as top 12.

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past January 26, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the rankings cannot be determined within this timeframe, all markets in this event will resolve to "No".

The resolution source will be official season-total statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).

events.title: Pro Football: 2026-27 Week 1 Receiving Yards Leader
events.description:
This market will resolve in favor of the player that finishes Week 1 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season with the most receiving yards.

Only games designated by the NFL as Week 1 of the 2026-27 regular season count.

In the event of a tie, this market will resolve in favor of the tied player with more receiving touchdowns in Week 1 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season. If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the player with a higher yards per reception average in Week 1 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season.
